resources.string: ModernMail is an open source email app focused on privacy and security. For this reason some features might work differently from what you are used to.
ModernMail does not display ads and does not track or analyze your behavior.
Some providers make it difficult to add an account. Please do not blame ModernMail for this, but ask for support instead.

Google will ask for permissions to read (to show messages to you), compose (to save draft messages), send and permanently delete all your email. ModernMail will never delete your messages without your explicit consent. Only you and no one else has access to your messages.
Add \'ModernMail search\' to Android text selection menu
Periodically check if ModernMail is still active
ModernMail does not have permission to read this file directly

Since ModernMail by default always receives messages, Android will report ModernMail as always being active. Therefore it might look as if ModernMail is always consuming battery power although this is in fact not the case.
By default, ModernMail reformats messages for privacy and security reasons. To view the original message, tap the \'full screen\' icon above the message text.
